name: Unsung Voice
description: Where the overtones of the held keys meet, a voice nobody is singing appears and walks from meeting to meeting over warm, close voices.

params.name: Body
params.description: What the keys are sung with: a throat, a wind reed, struck glass, a bowed string or a stopped pipe. The line takes its colour from it too.

params.name: Vowel
params.description: The mouth the keys and the line are sung through, from a closed hum through Oo, Ah and Eh to Ee. The throat has all of it, the other bodies less.

params.name: Tilt
params.description: Tips the keys' overtones down to a dark ground or up to a bright one. The level stays about the same and the line is left alone.

params.name: Closeness
params.description: How near the three singers of a key stand in pitch. Closed they are one voice; open they are a loose, wide section that never sits still.

params.name: Breath
params.description: Air in the voices. The keys breathe through the mouth as it is shaped, and the line gets a hiss at its own pitch.

params.name: Tolerance
params.description: How far apart two overtones may be and still be pulled together. Little leaves octaves and fifths; much adds thirds, sevenths and stranger meetings.

params.name: Lift
params.description: The balance of the two choirs. At zero the keys are alone, in the middle the line stands over them, and at the top the keys are almost gone.

params.name: Register
params.description: The highest pitch the line may take. It moves in the two octaves under this, so low settings bring it down among the keys.

params.name: Partner
params.description: A pitch nobody hears, this far above each key, whose overtones meet the key's own. With one key down it alone gives the line its notes. At zero there is none.

params.name: Lean
params.description: Which way the line walks. At the bottom it only falls, at the top it only climbs and begins again, and between them it wanders.

params.name: Pace
params.description: How long the line stands on one meeting before it moves to the next.

params.name: Glide
params.description: How much of each step is a slide. At zero one meeting fades into the next, at the top the line is nearly always on its way.

params.name: Linger
params.description: How long each tone of the line rings. Low settings strike it like a small bell at every meeting; at the top it is sung until it moves.

params.name: Second line
params.description: Level of a second line, which walks slower and the other way.

params.name: Vibrato
params.description: One vibrato for everything in a line, which holds its overtones together as a voice. The keys under it stay still.

params.name: Beating
params.description: Lets the overtones in the line go back towards where their keys have them. They no longer fuse but beat against each other, faster the further you go.

params.name: Colour
params.description: How much of a voice the line is, from one pure tone to a tone with its own octave, twelfth and what lies above.

params.name: Hold
params.description: How long a held key sounds. Low settings let the keys die like plucked strings while the line sings on over them.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How slowly the keys come in. Glass is quicker and the bow slower than this says, and the line waits a little for them.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long keys and line take to fade when the keys are let go.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the singers and the lines stand apart from left to right.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for this library: shared overtones of held keys found at control rate, pulled to one pitch and sung as a line, over additive voices with a mouth.
